basis: CNS malignancy; direct hypothalamic-pituitary injury commonly causes hormone loss, with pretreatment diabetes insipidus in approximately 30-55%.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: pretreatment diabetes insipidus affected 27/49 patients, supporting common direct pituitary dysfunction. [Cohort](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.pedneo.2020.07.017)

basis: Bowed-bone dysplasia and dysautonomia define the syndrome; corneal ulceration/opacities affect approximately 45% of longer-term survivors.

decisions.ocular: involved: corneal injury/opacities affect approximately 45% of survivors beyond age two, supporting involvement over the course. [Evidence](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9034487/)

basis: Persistent erection affects penile erectile tissue, outside these axes; altered local blood flow does not by itself establish a disease of vessels.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: the affected organ is penile erectile tissue; vascular ancestry and abnormal local flow alone do not establish intrinsic arterial or venous disease.

basis: Insulin-receptor autoantibodies cause metabolic dysfunction. Acanthosis is a nondamaging skin marker; nephritis and leukopenia reflect associated autoimmune disease.

decisions.dermatologic: none: acanthosis nigricans occurs in 80-99%, but persistent pigmentation and thickening alone do not establish destructive skin disease or loss of function.

basis: Congenital laryngeal obstruction directly affects the airway. Associated cardiovascular malformations are separate defects, despite their frequent HPO annotation.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: the 30-79% annotation describes associated cardiovascular malformations; isolated laryngeal atresia does not itself damage or malform the cardiovascular system.

basis: Mitochondrial Leigh encephalopathy; fixed contractures occur in 3/6 and kyphoscoliosis in 2/6. Strabismus alone does not establish ocular injury; optic atrophy occurs in 1/5.

decisions.neurologic: primary: Leigh or Leigh-like neurodegeneration is the defining clinical presentation, beyond an incidental complication. [Study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5544391/)
decisions.ocular: none: strabismus/exotropia in 2/6 can reflect neurologic motor dysfunction without direct ocular injury; documented optic atrophy is only 1/5.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: fixed joint contractures in 3/6 and kyphoscoliosis in 2/6 establish common structural impairment of joints and spine.

basis: Neurodevelopmental syndrome; congenital heart defects affect ~40-50%, persistent ocular dysfunction >50%, and hearing impairment ~40-65% in adults over the typical course.

decisions.ocular: involved: failed ocular emmetropization produces persistent significant refractive dysfunction in approximately 62%, beyond cosmetic findings. [Cohort](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12601024/)
decisions.otologic: involved: hearing-system dysfunction persists into adulthood; hearing loss affected 65% of adults, with premature auditory aging. [Cohort](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28654410/)

basis: Complement-mediated renal injury, hemolysis and thrombocytopenia; direct endothelial injury and microvascular thrombosis define symptomatic disease, beyond secondary hypertension.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: endothelial injury and capillary thrombosis are defining thrombotic microangiopathy, directly affecting vessels; the label does not rely on secondary hypertension.

basis: Severe bone fragility and deformity define type III; dentinogenesis imperfecta is explicitly a main defining feature. Scleral color alone does not establish ocular damage.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: the supplied definition explicitly includes dentinogenesis imperfecta among the main features of type III; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.

basis: Autoimmune blistering disease; oral erosions affected 15/30 patients in a clinical cohort, supporting ~50% involvement despite lower pooled reporting. Associated IBD is separate.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: direct oral mucosal blistering/erosions occurred in 15/30 patients, meeting the threshold; associated IBD is excluded. [Cohort](https://doi.org/10.2340/00015555-1065)
